title: Post-M2.2 exact-artifact GitHub Pages promotion
purpose: Repin the existing Learn-it GitHub Pages distribution to the exact human-promoted Atlas M2.2 artifact without changing product semantics or introducing runtime services.
invariants: Pages checks out the exact promoted M2.2 main integration rather than following moving main semantics.
The canonical deterministic build must reproduce exactly 366412 bytes and the frozen M2.2 SHA-256 before publication.
Published index.html and learnit-next.html are byte-identical copies of the verified artifact.
No product runtime, source manifest, QA oracle, storage, contract or learner-state file changes under this work package.
No backend, runtime API, LLM, account, synchronization, remote catalog or service worker is introduced.
No persistent hand-maintained gh-pages product fork is created.
requiredEvidence: PR diff contains exactly the Pages workflow and ATLAS-WP-007.json.
Deployment build proves exact promoted merge, artifact SHA-256 and byte length.
GitHub Pages deployment succeeds and records the stable URL.
adversarialTests: Reject deployment if checkout HEAD differs from the pinned promoted M2.2 main integration.
Reject deployment if build SHA-256 differs from the accepted M2.2 digest.
Reject deployment if build byte length differs from 366412.
Verify index.html and learnit-next.html are byte-identical before upload.
Reject any implementation delta outside the two authorized paths.
independentReview: Repository governance validates canonical package structure and repository invariants.
PR scope checks the exact two-path allowlist.
The deployment workflow fails closed on promotion-head, digest or byte-length drift.
nonGoals: Automatic publication of future product heads
rollback: Repin the Pages workflow to the previously promoted exact artifact or disable the deployment. Product main and learner state remain unchanged.
